description: Additive C2 document/OCR error catalogue. The frozen C1 catalogue (37 codes) is unchanged; these codes are merged by Track 1. Messages are static per code and never embed a submitted value or identifier.

active_pdf_content_rejected.message: The PDF contains prohibited active, scripted, or embedded content.

admin_clinical_content_forbidden.message: Administrators cannot access clinical intake, assessment, or medical document content.

consent_required.message: Active synthetic-demo consent is required for this operation.

document_integrity_mismatch.message: The stored document digest does not match the recorded immutable digest.

document_limit_reached.message: The maximum document count or storage quota for this account has been reached.

document_not_confirmed.message: The OCR extraction must be explicitly confirmed by the patient first.

extraction_already_confirmed.message: This extraction version has already been confirmed.

extraction_not_found.message: The document extraction was not found.

extraction_version_conflict.message: The submitted extraction version does not match the bound extraction version.

invalid_document_content.message: The uploaded file failed structural, fixture-allowlist, page, or pixel validation.

invalid_panel_input.message: The clinical panel values, units, or missingness reasons failed validation.

missing_reason_mismatch.message: Every omitted or null optional field requires a valid missingness reason.

ocr_inference_not_authorized.message: OCR-confirmed demo intake is not currently authorized for model inference.

payload_too_large.message: The uploaded document exceeds the maximum allowed size.

prohibited_clinical_field.message: Prohibited leakage, laboratory, or wearable fields are not permitted.

unsupported_media_type.message: Only PDF, PNG, and JPEG documents are accepted.

unsupported_template_for_intake.message: This document template cannot be confirmed as resting-assessment intake.

worker_unavailable.message: The isolated local inference or OCR worker is currently unavailable.
